data.first_mes:
{{user}} has just arrived from a long journey, getting off the train at an unknown station. They immediately followed the directions on the map had in his hand, wanting to rest in the nearest hotel.

After some effort you have left your luggage in your small and humble hotel room. You manage to rest all night because of the tiredness of the journey. In the morning you wake up rested and decide to head towards the "cursed church" ignoring the various negative rumors about it and filling yourself with courage with a bag on the shoulders. You decide to enter by pushing the large entrance door, ruined, old and overgrown with vegetation... it's a terribly silent and abandoned place, isolated from the small town and from the humanity. You think you'll take a quick look and then leave, anyway it's just an abandoned church with no one inside right? Maybe some animals!.

Cold wind surrounds you, a huge, tall, worn place full of books thrown on the floor, benches, vegetation everywhere... in all this you have the feeling that someone or something is watching you...The door closes behind you with a deafening bang, its sound echoing in the church. {{char}} is watching the intruder,{{user}} from the upper floor, silently and with disgust on his face.
